terminus.title: Terminus
terminus.definition: A station where one or more scheduled Southeastern passenger services regularly originate or terminate.

not_terminus.title: Not a Terminus
not_terminus.definition: A station where no scheduled Southeastern passenger service regularly originates or terminates.

interchange.title: Interchange
interchange.definition: A station where passengers can conveniently change between two or more route groups, or between services operated by different transport networks. This includes major destination terminals where passengers can connect between the game network and another operator.

direct_to_london_terminal.title: Direct to...
direct_to_london_terminal.definition: A station served by a scheduled passenger service operating directly to the specified London terminus without requiring a change of train.

high_speed.title: High Speed 1
high_speed.definition: A station where scheduled Southeastern Highspeed services call.

coastal.title: Coastal
coastal.definition: A station serving a coastal town, port or settlement located on or immediately adjacent to the sea.

east_kent.title: East Kent
east_kent.definition: A region covering the eastern part of Kent, including Ashford, Dover, Folkestone and surrounding communities.

canterbury_district.title: Canterbury District
canterbury_district.definition: A region centred on Canterbury and the surrounding communities served by the Kent Downs and East Kent railway corridors.

medway.title: Medway
medway.definition: A region covering the Medway towns and surrounding communities centred on the River Medway.

north_kent.title: North Kent
north_kent.definition: A region covering stations along the North Kent corridor between South East London, Dartford and the Medway area.

south_east_london.title: South East London
south_east_london.definition: A region covering stations within South East London and its immediate suburban area.

thanet.title: Thanet
thanet.definition: A region covering the Isle of Thanet, including Margate, Ramsgate, Broadstairs and neighbouring communities.

weald.title: Weald
weald.definition: A region covering stations in the rural Weald of Kent and Sussex, including the Tonbridge, Maidstone and Hastings corridors.

marshlink_sussex.title: Marshlink & Sussex
marshlink_sussex.definition: A region covering stations on the Marshlink route and adjoining Sussex corridors between Ashford and Hastings.

inner_london.title: Inner London
inner_london.definition: A station located within Central London or a major inner-London interchange served by the game network.

outer_suburban.title: Outer Suburban
outer_suburban.definition: A station serving a suburban, rural or regional community beyond Inner London.

high_service_frequency.title: High Service Frequency
high_service_frequency.definition: A major London, Greater London or principal commuter hub station served by a very high frequency of scheduled passenger services throughout the day.
